findings.body: The compact layout puts the complete title before the stage and total, then truncates the entire prefix at line 92, or the entire line here when Claude is busy or the next command is null. With the long title already used in pane.test.ts:131, the current stage begins around column 100, so a 79-column strip cannot display either its time or the total. This affects both surfaces. New evidence beyond the earlier timing ruling: the protected timing boxes apply only to lines 2–3; the narrow layout has only line 1. Reserve space for its required status and timings and shorten the title first. The narrow assertions at pane.test.ts:165–170 inspect unpainted text, so they pass despite this clipping.
findings.title: Not done: narrow summary strip preserves the current stage and its time

findings.body: This previous gap remains open: forge.toml:6 and .github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58 run pytest, while tests/test_mod_plugin.py:54–59 only type-checks the native tests.
